plan.title: AQ-OS Tools — honest integration/validation inventory
plan.goal: Every imported/built tool the AQ-OS refactor depends on, on the honest tier scale — DEFINED (referenced) -> INTEGRATED (installed/on PATH + wired) -> VALIDATED (a real call works) -> ACCEPTED (owner signed off). PRESENT proves installed, not that it's wired or works.
success_criteria: Every tool either present + validated, or honestly marked MISSING/unvalidated
Context-compression toolchain (rtk/headroom/lean-ctx), delegation lanes, MCP servers, osint tools all accounted for
Owner sign-off per tool before it counts as done
plan.tier_model: DEFINED=referenced in docs; INTEGRATED=on PATH/installed + wired; VALIDATED=a real invocation works; ACCEPTED=owner signed off. detection.command projects presence from `which`; acceptance.status must be 'accepted' for complete.
